cover_html:
5 PROMPTS · PRICE QUESTIONS
SAMPLE · HOUSE CLEANING · NEW TEXT
How much?
3 bedrooms, this Friday?
DELIVERED 6:12 PM
Answer the price text
Book the job
$180, about 3 hours. Friday at 9 AM or 1 PM?
5 Claude prompts for every price question. Swipe ▸

slides.title: Save *ready answers*
slides.prompt: Here is my price list: [paste]. Write ready to send answers to the 3 price questions I get most: [questions]. Each one gives the price, what is included, how long it takes, and one question that books the job. Under 40 words each.
slides.why: Research in Harvard Business Review: firms that replied within an hour were about 7 times as likely to land a real conversation.

slides.title: When it *depends*
slides.prompt: A customer asked: [paste]. My price depends on [size, condition, model]. Reply with my starting price, [price], say in one line what changes it, and ask for the one detail or photo I need to give a firm number.
slides.why: They get a real number now, and you get the one detail you need for a firm quote.

slides.title: Give *3 options*
slides.prompt: Turn my [service] into 3 options for this customer: basic, standard and full, using my prices [prices]. One line each on what is included. End by asking which one fits. No pressure, no fake deadlines.
slides.why: Options let each customer pick the package that fits their needs and budget.

slides.title: When they ask for *cheaper*
slides.prompt: A customer asked: [paste]. My price is [price] and I will not drop it for the same job. Write a friendly reply that says what the price covers in one line and offers a smaller job: [what I can leave out] for [lower price].
slides.why: Change the scope, not the price of the same job.

slides.title: Raising *your prices*
slides.prompt: My prices go up on [date], from [old] to [new], because [real reason]. Write a short, warm text for my regular customers: thank them, state the change and the date, give the reason in one line, and invite questions. No apology.
slides.why: Give a few weeks of notice and the real reason. You do not need to apologize.

cta.gift: Free Front Desk Starter: replies to customers in your voice.
cta.small: Free in your DMs. *It drafts, you send.*
